description: This file contains unit tests for the UserService class within the book project, focusing on user-related functionalities such as registration, login, password changes, deletion, and lock management.

classes.name: UserServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing UserService methods

methods.name: register_throwsNullPointerException_ifUserIsNull
methods.description: Asserts that the register method throws NullPointerException when null user is passed.

methods.name: findUserById_searchesRepository
methods.description: Verifies that findUserById invokes the repository method.

methods.name: findUserById_throwsNullPointerException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown if null ID is provided.

methods.name: findUserByEmail_searchesRepository
methods.description: Verifies that findUserByEmail invokes the repository method.

methods.name: findUserByEmail_throwsNullPointerException_ifEmailIsNull
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown if null email is provided.

methods.name: isEmailInUse_throwsNullPointerException_ifEmailIsNull
methods.description: Checks that method throws if null email.

methods.name: returnTrueIfEmailInUse
methods.description: Returns true when email is found in the repository.

methods.name: returnFalseIfEmailInUse
methods.description: Returns false when email is not found in the repository.

methods.name: changeUserEmail_throwsIncorrectPasswordException_ifPasswordIncorrect

methods.name: changeUserPassword_encodesPassword_beforeSaving
